old: I can report direct statements in Hungarian without tense backshifting.
new: I can report what someone said with azt mondta, hogy ….

old: I can shift personal pronouns, persons, and temporal adverbs accurately.
new: I can change én to ő and itt, ma, holnap to ott, aznap, másnap.

old: I can use 4 key terms for reported statements and citing.
new: I can name a statement, a quotation and a message.

old: I can transform direct utterances into elegant indirect discourse.
new: I can tell reported speech from a direct quotation.

old: I can use formal reporting verbs in press releases and official statements.
new: I can report an official statement with bejelentette, hogy … and hangsúlyozta, hogy ….

old: I can formulate clear denials and refutations using tagadja and cáfolja.
new: I can report a denial with tagadta, hogy … and cáfolta, hogy ….

old: I can acquire 4 media and press reporting terms.
new: I can name a news source, a spokesperson and a statement.

old: I can summarize news reports with accurate attribution.
new: I can say what a position statement is.

old: I can form indirect polar questions using the enclitic -e on verbs or focus.
new: I can report a yes/no question with hogy … -e.

old: I can report information questions beginning with question words without -e.
new: I can report a question with a question word, without -e.

old: I can use 4 inquiry and information-gathering vocabulary words.
new: I can name inquiry, interest and information in Hungarian.

old: I can conduct polite inquiries and report interview questions.
new: I can say what orientation and information mean.

old: I can report imperative commands using subjunctive clauses with hogy.
new: I can report a command with hogy and -jon/-jen.

old: I can report polite requests using kéri, hogy... and governing structures.
new: I can report a polite request with megkérte, hogy ….

old: I can use 4 directive, petition, and claim vocabulary words.
new: I can name an instruction, a notice, a petition and a demand.

old: I can adjust reporting tone from strict orders to polite invitations.
new: I can say when a request is formal (kérelem) and when it is a demand (követelés).

old: I can express unverified rumors and hearsay using állítólag and úgy hírlik.
new: I can mark a rumour with állítólag and úgy hírlik, hogy ….

old: I can cite and attribute sources using arra hivatkozik and szavai szerint.
new: I can give a source with a hírek szerint and a sajtóértesülés szerint.

old: I can use 4 vocabulary terms for rumors, gossip, and media coverage.
new: I can name a rumour, gossip, a denial and a press report.
